turns.text: So, as you can kind of see, Mark and I, you know, don't totally agree, but I think what Mark's going to probably do is tell tell us his side.
turns.zh: 所以，你们大概也看得出来，马克和我，你知道吧，意见不完全一致，但我觉得马克接下来大概会说说他那一方的看法。

turns.text: You know, I disagree with that, but I'm going to be playing devil's advocate and I'm going to actually agree with her so you get both sides of this.
turns.zh: 你知道吧，我不同意那个观点，但我要故意唱反调，实际上我会同意她的说法，这样你们就能听到双方的观点。

turns.text: I think in my opinion the idea that it's just self-discipline is a bit naive.
turns.zh: 我觉得，在我看来，认为这仅仅是自律的问题有点天真。

turns.text: Like, it's very easy to say, oh, just put your phone down.
turns.zh: 就像，说起来很容易，哦，把手机放下就行了。

turns.text: If it gets too much, just turn it off and walk away.
turns.zh: 如果太过分了，就关掉走开。
